findings.title: Provider failure prevents local session termination
findings.scenario: Support resets a compromised account whose policy is OPTIONAL and preference is off. Credential listing, deletion or provider logout throws while the attacker holds an application web session.
findings.expected: Reset attempts local session termination independently of provider failure.
findings.actual: The exception skips sessions.endAllFor. The reset epoch blocks earlier MFA proofs, but ordinary protected API calls remain accessible through the surviving web session when MFA is not required.
findings.evidence: Lines 105–110 place all provider calls before local deletion inside one try block. MfaEnforcementFilter.java checks the reset epoch only when decision.required() is true. MfaResetAuditIntegrationTest exercises second-deletion failure but checks session deletion only after a subsequent successful retry. This concerns surviving web sessions, not the documented five-minute bearer-token lifetime.
findings.suggested_fix: Attempt local session termination independently after recording the reset epoch, preserving and auditing failures from both local and provider operations.
findings.repro_test: Create an OPTIONAL/preference-off account with an existing web session; inject credential-deletion and logout failures separately; reset it and verify its Spring Session rows are removed and its old cookie cannot access protected APIs.

findings.title: Initial environment file is readable before chmod
findings.scenario: On a shared host with traversable workspace directories and umask 022, another local user watches for initial infra/.env creation and opens it before chmod runs.
findings.expected: Credential files have owner-only permissions from creation.
findings.actual: Shell redirection creates the file with permissive inherited permissions, writes generated credentials, then chmod restricts it. The new umask 077 occurs later in render_realm and does not protect ensure_env.
findings.evidence: Lines 38–44 write the environment file before chmod 600; up calls ensure_env before render_realm, where umask 077 is set at line 60. An already-open file descriptor remains readable after chmod.
findings.suggested_fix: Set umask 077 before any environment-file creation, preferably at script startup.
findings.repro_test: Use synthetic marker values under umask 022 and assert the environment file is mode 600 immediately upon creation, without printing its contents.
